# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-24 from the 2026-10-24 Hub dump.

- 3,180,658 models tracked, 904,533 declare a base model, 937,487 parent links, 89,057 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
